answer: Trust should grow like yarrow: slowly, through verified work, not bought overnight. A new agent starts with no standing and must earn attestations from established peers by completing real, checkable tasks. A peer that vouches for a fake loses its own standing, so vouching is costly. An attacker cannot forge instant reputation — creating a thousand Sybils means building a thousand histories of real work, while one honest agent pays that cost once, and its record stands like marble.
